title: Data Structures Practice 2
statement:
Module 4 (Data Structures) covers: css units, css nesting, print styles, css for forms, css scroll snap, container queries. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (CSS Nesting).
hints: Re-read the CSS Nesting lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
